shellCommands.command: cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && echo ---- && ls -la && cat package.json && cat AGENTS.md && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.git/' | head -50

cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx index.html vite.config.ts tsconfig.json && echo ---- && sed -n 1,80p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && echo ---- && grep -n -i -A6 'charts\|chartkit' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -80 && echo ---- && grep -n -i -B2 -A12 'theme' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md | head -120 && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/

npm install @gravity-ui/charts 2>&1 | tail -5 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/package.json | grep -E '"version"|peerDependencies' -A6 | head -20 && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/ && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head
npm install @gravity-ui/charts 2>&1 | grep -v '^npm error$' | head -40
npm view @gravity-ui/charts versions --json 2>/dev/null | tail -15 && for v in 1.14.0 1.15.0 1.16.0; do echo "== $v"; npm view @gravity-ui/charts@$v peerDependencies --json 2>/dev/null; done

npm view @gravity-ui/charts@1.73.0 peerDependencies --json && npm install @gravity-ui/charts@^1.73.0 2>&1 | tail -3 && grep '"version"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/package.json && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/ && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head -30; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head -30

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs && cat INDEX.md && echo ---- && cat get-started.md && echo ---- && ls guides && echo ---- && grep -n -i -C4 'theme\|dark\|light\|Required setup\|styles.css' ../../README.md | head -80
cat guides/theming.md && echo ---- && cat guides/colors.md && echo ---- && cat guides/series-types/line.md && echo ---- && sed -n 1,120p guides/axes/axis-types.md

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/ && grep -rn "export" node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/index.d.ts | head -30; echo ----; grep -rn -i "palette\|DEFAULT_PALETTE" node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/constants/*.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/constants/*.js 2>/dev/null | head -20; echo ----; grep -n "useTheme\|useThemeType\|useThemeValue" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/index.d.ts; echo ----; grep -n -A12 "export interface ChartData\b" node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/types/chart/*.d.ts | head -60

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm; cat $D/index.d.ts; echo ----; grep -rln "DEFAULT_PALETTE" $D | head; grep -rn -A2 "DEFAULT_PALETTE =" $D --include=*.js | head -20; echo ----; grep -n -A14 "export interface ChartData\b\|export type ChartData\b" $D/types/chart/*.d.ts $D/types/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -50; echo ----; grep -n -A8 "export interface ChartProps\|export type ChartProps" -r $D --include=*.d.ts | head -40; echo ----; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/useTheme.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/useThemeType.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/useThemeValue.d.ts; echo ----; sed -n 1,80p node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs/guides/legend.md; echo ----; grep -n -B2 -A10 "## Axis title\|title" node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs/guides/axes/index.md | head -60

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm; cat $D/core/constants/palette.js; echo ----; grep -n -B2 -A24 "export interface ChartData<" -r $D/types --include=*.d.ts | head -60; echo ----; grep -n -A30 "export interface ChartXAxis\b" $D/types/chart/axis.d.ts | head -60; echo ----; grep -n -A12 "export interface ChartTitle\|export interface ChartAxisTitle" -r $D/types --include=*.d.ts | head -40; echo ----; grep -n -A20 "export interface ChartLegend\b" -r $D/types --include=*.d.ts | head -30; echo ----; grep -n -A14 "export interface ChartMargin\|export interface ChartTooltip\b" -r $D/types --include=*.d.ts | head -40

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm; ls $D/types $D/types/chart 2>/dev/null; echo ----; grep -rn "interface ChartData\b\|interface ChartData<\|type ChartData\b\|type ChartData<" $D/types | head; echo ----; F=$(grep -rln "interface ChartData\b\|interface ChartData<" $D/types | head -1); echo "FILE: $F"; grep -n -A30 "interface ChartData" $F | head -50

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm; cat $D/types/index.d.ts | head -30; echo ----; grep -rn "ChartData\b" $D --include=*.d.ts -l | head -5; echo ----; F=$(grep -rln "interface ChartData\b\|interface ChartData<\|type ChartData<" $D --include=*.d.ts | head -1); echo "FILE: $F"; grep -n -A32 "interface ChartData\|type ChartData<" "$F" | head -50; echo ----; ls $(dirname "$F")

T=node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types; sed -n 73,120p $T/index.d.ts; echo ---- AXIS; ls $T/chart; grep -n -A6 "^export interface ChartXAxis\b\|^export interface ChartYAxis\b\|^export interface ChartAxis\b" $T/chart/axis.d.ts | head -40; grep -n "^\s*\(type\|title\|labels\|grid\|min\|max\|lineColor\|visible\|ticks\|categories\|plotLines\|crosshair\|timestamps\)?*:" $T/chart/axis.d.ts | head -40; echo ---- TITLE; grep -n -A14 "^export interface ChartTitle\|^export interface ChartAxisTitle\|^export interface ChartOptions" $T/chart/title.d.ts $T/chart/chart.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -60; echo ---- LEGEND; grep -n "^\s*\(enabled\|position\|align\|layout\|type\|html\)?*:" $T/chart/legend.d.ts | head; echo ---- TOOLTIP; grep -n "^\s*\(enabled\|renderer\|valueFormat\|pin\|throttle\|totals\)?*:" $T/chart/tooltip.d.ts | head; echo ---- LINE; grep -n -B1 -A3 "^\s*\(type\|name\|data\|color\|lineWidth\|marker\|dashStyle\|interpolation\|yAxis\|visible\)?*:" $T/chart/line-series.d.ts | head -80

T=node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types; sed -n 1,60p $T/chart/line.d.ts | grep -v '^\s*\*\|^\s*/\*\*'; echo ---- AXIS; sed -n 1,60p $T/chart/axis.d.ts | grep -v '^\s*\*\|^\s*/\*\*'; sed -n 100,135p $T/chart/axis.d.ts | grep -v '^\s*\*\|^\s*/\*\*'; sed -n 210,300p $T/chart/axis.d.ts | grep -v '^\s*\*\|^\s*/\*\*'; echo ---- VALUEFORMAT; grep -n -A12 "export type ValueFormat\b\|export interface ValueNumberFormat\|export interface ValueFormatNumber" $T/chart/*.d.ts $T/*.d.ts | grep -v '^\S*-\s*\*' | head -40; echo ---- TRAPS; grep -n -A8 "## Typography\|### Typography\|header-3\|## Flex\|### .*flex" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md | head -70

cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs | head -80; echo ---- TP; U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components; grep -n -A20 "export interface ThemeProviderProps" $U/theme/ThemeProvider.d.ts | grep -v '^\S*-\s*\*'; grep -n "Theme\b\|ThemeType\|themeValue\|RealTheme" $U/theme/types.d.ts | head; echo ---- TEXT; grep -n "TEXT_VARIANTS\|'header-1'\|'body-1'\|subheader" $U/Text/text/*.d.ts $U/Text/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -8; echo ---- CARD; grep -n "view?\|type?\|size?\|theme?" $U/Card/Card.d.ts | head; echo ---- SEG; ls $U | grep -i "segmented\|RadioButton\|Switch\|Flex\|Box"; grep -n "options?\|value?\|onUpdate?\|size?" $U/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; grep -n "export interface SegmentedRadioGroupOptionProps" -A8 $U/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -12

U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components; grep -n -A12 "export interface ControlGroupProps" $U/types.d.ts | grep -v '^\S*-\s*\*'; grep -n -A6 "export interface ControlGroupOption" $U/types.d.ts | grep -v '^\S*-\s*\*'; echo ---- GROOT; grep -o "\.g-root[^{]*{[^}]*}" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | head -3; grep -o "body{[^}]*}" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | head -2; echo ---- DATAVIZ; sed -n 1,60p /tmp/claude-1000/bundled-skills/2.1.319/38c8d0a14f96de389c54c849d847515a/dataviz/references/palette.md | head -60; echo ---- VALIDATE; node /tmp/claude-1000/bundled-skills/2.1.319/38c8d0a14f96de389c54c849d847515a/dataviz/scripts/validate_palette.js "#4DA2F1,#FF3D64,#8AD554,#FFC636" --mode light 2>&1 | tail -25; node /tmp/claude-1000/bundled-skills/2.1.319/38c8d0a14f96de389c54c849d847515a/dataviz/scripts/validate_palette.js "#4DA2F1,#FF3D64,#8AD554,#FFC636" --mode dark 2>&1 | tail -25

sed -i "s|valueFormat: { type: 'number', precision: 0, unit: 'k' },|valueFormat: { type: 'number', precision: 0, postfix: ' тыс.' },|" src/App.tsx && grep -n "valueFormat" src/App.tsx && rm -rf dist && npx tsc --noEmit && echo TSC_OK && git status --short
